title: Two more ways to make images and dreams
summary:
Two community apps joined the showcase, contributor links were tidied up, and Polly got better at searching for support answers.

The app catalog added @mowenyun’s Multimodal Image Generator, which offers configurable image generation through the Pollinations API, and @newsister’s DREAMMELD, which combines dream interpretation with imagery and ambient soundscapes.

The README’s Latest News and Recent Apps sections were refreshed, replacing placeholder links for three showcased apps with their contributors’ profiles.

Polly added code and documentation indexing and now prioritizes repository and documentation search for support questions. The update also gives configured Discord collaborators limited GitHub issue-management actions and adds safeguards for longer bot tasks.
